subTitle: Ask us anything about our brand and products, and get factual responses.

faqs.question: What's included in the Basic Service plan?
faqs.answer: The Basic Service plan covers essential AI-powered tools and website hosting for small-scale needs, including standard support and access to core Airdb features. It's a curated starting point for teams getting started with AI in their workflows.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Basic Service to the Professional plan?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade at any time to access a wider range of premium features, enjoy priority customer support, and receive exclusive content. Contact our support team for a seamless transition.

faqs.question: What discounts are available for enterprise or bulk agreements?
faqs.answer: Enterprise customers are entitled to exclusive discounts, the percentage of which may vary depending on scale. Get in touch with us to discuss your needs, and we'll provide a tailored quote.

faqs.question: What kind of customer support can I expect?
faqs.answer: All our customers receive dedicated email support. With Basic Service you'll receive our standard support, while the Professional plan upgrades you to priority support, meaning faster response times and specialized assistance.

faqs.question: How current are the online resources and documentation?
faqs.answer: We regularly update our documentation and guides to reflect the latest developments in AI, data, and security, as well as new product features. Our material aims to be comprehensive and user-friendly for all skill levels.

faqs.question: Does Airdb offer services for large-scale enterprise projects?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Enterprise Solutions are designed for larger companies requiring comprehensive services. We provide consultation, planning, and technical implementation, as well as staffing solutions for substantial projects. Contact us for a customized quote.
